title: Michigan–Ohio Geology Core Atlas — pilot 1
scope: Four Michigan and three Ohio physical geological cores. Purposive accessibility pilot; not representative statewide sampling. No archaeological-site selection.
selection: Michigan: MGS catalogue query Total_Depth < 600 ft, followed by physical-core code C, location availability and usable lithology across four counties. Ohio: public physical-core inventory, near-surface records and accessible original logs across three counties. Download failures and catalogue errors affect this convenience sample; 600 ft is a retrieval filter, not a geological or historical cutoff.
